description: Lake Nyos, Cameroon (Fafnir-ID format): the crater lake that erupted without a sound in 1986 — a limnic eruption of magmatic CO2 that suffocated 1,746 people; today it degasses slowly through pipes. Full episode composition (Remotion + three.js), rendered in chunks on GitHub Actions.
name: fafnir-nyos-danau-meledak
